card.name: Inside Wiltshire and Wilting-type words
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the middle or end piece of a split word that starts with W or Wil, such as Wiltshire, Wilts and wilting. It also fires on a few other split words such as Warton, sputtered, sweltering and tepid.
